results.controlIntent: The developer of the system, system component, or system service is required to produce a plan for continuous monitoring of control effectiveness; that plan is consistent with the continuous monitoring program of the organization.

judgment.rationale:
SA-4(8).r1 requires a substantive, effective continuous monitoring plan for control effectiveness. The evidence reveals two critical deficiencies:

1. **Monitoring is non-functional**: The sole monitoring schedule (`churn-predictor-data-quality`) has a last run status of "Failed" with the reason "No capture data found — data capture is disabled." Because data capture is disabled on the endpoint, the monitoring schedule cannot collect or analyze any inference data. A monitoring plan that cannot execute is not substantive — it exists in name only.

2. **Monitoring coverage is severely incomplete**: Only a single DataQuality schedule exists. There are no schedules for ModelQuality (prediction accuracy drift), ModelBias (fairness monitoring), or ModelExplainability (feature attribution drift). A continuous monitoring plan consistent with organizational standards would typically address multiple dimensions of model health, not just data quality — and even that single dimension is currently broken.

Together, these gaps mean the continuous monitoring plan is neither operationally effective nor sufficiently comprehensive to satisfy the control's intent of ongoing, substantive monitoring of control effectiveness.
gaps: Data capture configuration for the endpoint (must be enabled for any monitoring to function)
ModelQuality monitoring schedule (tracks prediction accuracy/drift against ground truth)
ModelBias monitoring schedule (tracks fairness metrics over time)
ModelExplainability monitoring schedule (tracks feature attribution drift)
Organizational continuous monitoring program documentation to verify alignment
Baseline statistics and constraints artifacts for existing DataQuality schedule
Human attestation on whether a compensating monitoring mechanism exists outside SageMaker Model Monitor
